component.name: OpenXplorer
component.summary: Explorer-style local and SMB file manager

description.p: This package is published by OpenXplorer's developer. It installs the official Debian package from OpenXplorer's GitHub releases, unmodified.

Browse local folders, SMB shares and connected phones in a tabbed window styled after Windows 11 File Explorer, with light and dark appearances, a resizable sidebar, indexed filename search and ZIP, TAR and 7z browsing.

Installation does not change file associations, browser preferences or network mounts. Making OpenXplorer the default file manager, handling Show in folder requests and the other desktop integrations stay off until you turn them on in Settings.
A few of those optional features need a permission that is not granted by default; enable the ones you use with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open in Terminal and making OpenXplorer the default file manager (runs host programs, so it lifts the sandbox): flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak io.winspace.Development
Answering Show in folder requests from other apps: flatpak override --user --own-name=org.freedesktop.FileManager1 io.winspace.Development
Format… on a removable drive: flatpak override --user --system-talk-name=org.freedesktop.UDisks2 io.winspace.Development
The check for new releases (Flatpak installs updates either way): flatpak override --user --share=network io.winspace.Development
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset io.winspace.Development
